2121396238746607818.en_summary: (Reposted by @Jason) This Week in Startups notes that Rockstar spent 8 years building “GTA VI” (coming next week). But Fable 5.2 can create a realistic, explorable map of Manhattan in just seven days. Questions if there is any hope for AAA game studios when anyone can build a basic game with AI in a few hours. Jason suggests tech won’t immediately kill major studios but will supercharge indie scene, similar to digital cameras and independent film. Mentions $TTWO.
2121396238746607818.zh_summary: （由@Jason轉發）This Week in Startups指出Rockstar花了8年建造「GTA VI」（下週推出）。但Fable 5.2能在短短七天內創建曼哈頓的現實可探索地圖。質疑在任何人能用AI在幾小時內建造基本遊戲的世界裡，AAA遊戲工作室是否還有希望。Jason建議技術不會立即殺死主要工作室，但會極大推動獨立遊戲場景，類似數碼相機對獨立電影的革命。提及$TTWO。

2121348811675054553.en_summary: Carl Quintanilla shares a four-byline alert: upon seeing the raw intelligence, US officials requested that the American’s name be “unmasked”— revealing the individual to be the now-former NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, the sources said. @CNN $NVDA.

2121348797276320087.en_summary: The Kobeissi Letter reports BREAKING: Elon Musk announces that a petition is currently underway to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia, $NVDA. Musk says he will be signing the petition and supports Jensen Huang's return to the company.
2121348797276320087.zh_summary: The Kobeissi Letter報導突發：Elon Musk宣布目前有請願正在進行，要求重新任命黃仁勳為英偉達$NVDA首席執行官。Musk表示他將簽署請願並支持黃仁勳回歸公司。
